decision: Scan set = Drive 'Full Scans' 2026-07-26 session: Full Car (1eEahwd9..., 34,994,797 tris) + its part and state scans (front bumper, rear bumper forced, rear wing, left fender, side skirts F/R, side fin, left mirror, headlights, tail lights L/R; states hood open, front bumper+headlights removed, rear bumper off (TL off), rear wing removed, fender removed, side skirts & fin removed)
why: Same capture session as the full car so they share its Artec frame; the 2024 'Full Scan' and the 'VF Scans' exhaust set are other sessions. Only our scan data, no CAD

decision: One rigid levelling transform for every scan (projects/huracan-evo/tools/level.py fit on the 4 mm full car, applied to all STLs): ground normal (-0.007, 0.043, 0.999) -> +Z, nose at -Y; then ive crop + floor cut z<8 mm + prep --units mm with every part/state prepped --like blend/car_4mm.json
why: Raw frame tilted ~2.5 deg; one shared transform keeps parts registered (lesson: pin with --like). The footprint crop left ~80k sub-floor noise tris down to -175 mm, cut by tools/floorcut.py

decision: Registration verified numerically (tools/regcheck.py vs 4 mm car): every part/state sits 1.5-2.6 mm median from the car surface on its overlap; ICP would move them <=13 mm/0.33 deg (side skirt front diverges on its 16k-point overlap, median 3.9 mm already) -> no corrections applied
why: Same-session Artec exports share the frame; 2 mm is the decimation noise floor. Visual overlay check still to do before the exploded view

decision: End card logo = illumaesthetic.com IllumaestheticLogo_V2COMPLETE_1.png (6135x1059 RGBA) copied to remotion/public/illumaesthetic_logo.png
why: File is gitignored and was missing; brief says get it from the website. Transparent V2 version sits cleanly on black

decision: Visual registration check: every part rendered at home in a tint colour over the silver 3 mm car (front 3/4, left side, rear 3/4, top) -> chk/reg_overlay.jpg
why: Brief + lesson: look, not just the score. Tints z-fight in patchwork with the car surface everywhere (bumpers, fender, skirts, fin, mirror, wing, tail lights) with no offset copies or double edges = registered

decision: Side skirts: no ive crop / no prep --drop-islands, floor cut z<8 mm only
why: Skirt blades sit 0-50 mm above the ground; ive crop (up-facing faces in the bottom 22 cm) cut the front skirt 157k->25k tris and prep's 'island never above 15 cm' rule deleted it entirely

decision: Front lid = full-car triangles in the nose's top surface that the 'Hood Open' scan no longer has (>10 mm away), tools/hood.py; it opens on a fitted hinge: axis ~X at y=-1.317 m z=0.813 m (levelled mm frame), -67.8 deg = the captured open lid, median fit 1.5 mm (tools/hinge.py -> hinge.json)
why: No separate hood part scan exists; cutting the lid out of the car and fitting the hinge to the real open-lid capture makes the hood-open beat physically right (Huracan sibling method)

decision: Exploded base = 3 mm car minus every panel the part scans cover (<6 mm) + six zone state scans as captured (front bumper+headlights removed, hood open, fender removed, skirts+fin removed, rear bumper off TL off, wing removed), adding only triangles >6 mm from the base AND >8 mm from every part at home AND not above the car's top surface; re-decimated to 3 mm (tools/composite.py)
why: State scans still contain the other parts (e.g. the bumper in 'Fender Removed'), which would stay behind as ghosts when those parts fly off; the roofline rule drops Hood Open's raised lid

decision: Full-car beats (turntables, headlight close-up) render the assembled composite (base + all 12 part scans at home), not the raw Full Car scan
why: Low front render of the raw full car showed the lower fascia full of holes (dark trims not captured, radiators and the wheel visible through); with the separately scanned front bumper + headlights at home the fascia is complete (test/nose vs nose_asm). Also keeps the car identical across every shot up to the explode

decision: Shot order (Temerario ref): s1 low side track (nose right, fade up) -> s2 front 3/4 turntable -> s3 rear 3/4 turntable -> s4 headlight ECU (2 mm parts) -> s5 front-left wheel ECU (2 mm zone of the raw car) -> s6 front opens (bumper off, headlights out, lid up on its hinge) -> s7 top-down spin -> s8 exploded build -> s9 side float -> s10 reassembly rear 3/4 + fade -> logo card
why: Brief order: turntables/orbits, extreme close-ups, panels open where state scans allow (hood open state + front-bumper/headlights-removed state), top-down, exploded separate+reassemble, logo

decision: Exploded layout stacks panels above the car in layers (bumpers +0.9 m, headlights 1.3, hood 1.7, wing 1.25, tail lights 1.6; left-side panels only 0.3-0.4 m out toward the camera); explode/float cameras pulled to 10-11.6 m

decision: s6 front-open camera pulled in 6.0 -> 4.6 m

decision: Beat grid = 102.52 BPM fitted to 20 strong flux onsets on a 16th grid (phase 0.0833 s, residuals <=3 ms); beats at 0.5222 + 0.58525*m; ive beats' 103.4 BPM drifted 85 ms over 16 s
why: Lesson: verify the grid on real hits. Phrase starts (flux jumps) at 9.30, 18.66 and the taiko climax at 28.03 are 16 beats apart

decision: Measured the end: loud section 27.9-31.3 s (RMS -11..-13 dBFS), then decay -26 dB at 32 s, -45 dB at 34.6 s, silent ~39 s. Reel ends at 34.6 s (music fade 1.0 s)

decision: Cuts on bar downbeats / strong onsets with varied holds (8,4,4,2,2,6,6,8,4 beats): 4.62 front34, 6.96 rear34, 9.30 headlight (phrase B), 10.47 wheel, 11.64 front opens (lid lifts on the 13.98 bar), 15.15 top-down, 18.66 explode (phrase C), 23.35 float, 25.69 reassemble, parts slam home (ease-in) on the climax taiko attack 27.97, logo on the loudest taiko hit 30.40
why: Lessons: cut on accents, vary holds, land the money moment on the drop. The build is long and quiet, so the climax carries the lock-together and the logo; whole-frame durs, first clip one frame short
